intro.value: A town campsite in the centre of Seyðisfjörður, the fjord town where the Smyril Line ferry Norröna docks, sheltered by trees and divided into small areas. The service house has showers, toilets, cooking facilities, a dining/sitting room, washing machine and dryer and free internet, and there is electricity and a WC emptying point for motorhomes. The shop, pool (with sauna and hot tubs), restaurants, Rainbow Street and the Blue Church are a short walk away. It is a summer campsite: the operator's published 2026 season is 1 April – 31 October, and no bookings are taken.

address.note: The campsite's own contact page and tjalda.is give Ránargata 1; ferdalag.is, Visit Iceland and Visit Austurland give Ránargata 5. Same campsite in the town centre.

season.value: 2026: 1 April – 31 October (the campsite's own website, tjalda.is and the Camping Card 2026 list). Ferdalag.is and Visit Austurland still show an older 1 May – 30 September season.

winter.value: Closed in winter. The operator's own website, tjalda.is and the Camping Card list all give a 2026 season of 1 April – 31 October, and the municipality's lease periods also run 1 April – 31 October. Ferdalag.is lists it on its camper winter service list and tags it 'Camper winter service', but the same listing says 'Open in the summer' with dates 01/05–30/09, and no source gives any winter dates or services, so do not plan a November–March night here without contacting the campsite first (+354 792 0070). The nearest year-round alternative is Camp Egilsstaðir, which tjalda.is lists as open year-round. Check road conditions on road.is before driving in winter.

electricity.value: Yes – electricity for motorhomes, 1,500 ISK per night (2026). Number of hook-ups and socket type are Unconfirmed.

kitchen.value: Yes – indoor cooking facilities, dining room and sitting room in the service house; outdoor grill.

showers.value: Yes – hot showers in the service house (price Unconfirmed).

dump_station.value: Yes – Icelandic sources describe a 'hreinsiaðstaða fyrir húsbíla-wc' (cleaning/emptying facility for motorhome toilets), and ferdalag.is / Visit Austurland tag it 'Waste tank discharge' ('Losun skólptanka'). Exact location on site and whether grey water can also be emptied are Unconfirmed; ask at reception. Available only in the open season.

laundry.value: Washing machine and tumble dryer, 800 ISK each (2026)

camping_card.value: Yes – Seyðisfjörður is on the Camping Card (Útilegukortið) 2026 list (1 April – 31 October). Whether electricity or the lodging tax is extra for card holders is Unconfirmed.

practical.value: No booking: the campsite says bookings are not possible and that it cannot reserve a space for you, so arrive and pick a free spot. Reception hours on the website: 07–14 and 17–23.
Handy for the Norröna ferry: the campsite describes itself as made for ferry travellers' first and last night, and ferdalag.is lists the car ferry about 0.5 km away.
Age limit 18 unless travelling with adults. Dogs are allowed (since summer 2017) if owners follow the site rules.

Within walking distance: grocery store, swimming pool with sauna and hot tubs, restaurants, the Technical Museum of East Iceland and the Skaftfell art centre. Bike rental is available in the campsite's parking lot.

The campsite may move: Múlaþing municipality is designing a new campsite at Ránargata (preliminary design presented January 2026), and in October 2025 the Seyðisfjörður local council urged that a new campsite be ready for use in 2027; the current operator's contract was extended for one year. Re-check the location and operator before the 2027 season.
